title: Wuthering Heights
author: Emily Brontë
descr: The story of Heathcliff and Catherine Earnshaw and the passion that destroys both families on the Yorkshire moors.

title: Jane Eyre
author: Charlotte Brontë
descr: An orphaned governess finds independence and love at Thornfield Hall, despite the secret kept by its master, Mr. Rochester.

title: The Raven
author: Edgar Allen Poe
descr: A narrative poem in which a grieving man is visited at midnight by a talking raven that answers every question with "Nevermore".

title: Eleonora
author: Edgar Allen Poe
descr: A short story about a man's love for his cousin Eleonora and the promise he makes to her before she dies.

title: Catweazle
author: Richard Carpenter
descr: An eleventh-century wizard falls through time into the modern world and mistakes electricity for magic.

title: Villette
author: Charlotte Brontë
descr: Lucy Snowe leaves England to teach at a girls' school in the fictional town of Villette.

title: Shirley
author: Charlotte Brontë
descr: Set during the Luddite unrest in Yorkshire, two very different women face love and social change.

title: The Tell-Tale Heart
author: Edgar Allan Poe
descr: A narrator insists on his sanity while describing a murder he committed and the beating heart he cannot stop hearing.

title: The Fall of the House of Usher
author: Edgar Allan Poe
descr: A visitor watches his childhood friend Roderick Usher and the family mansion slowly decay together.

title: Catweazle and the Magic Zodiac
author: Richard Carpenter
descr: Catweazle returns and searches for the twelve signs of the zodiac to open his way home.
